meta.title: Bitcoin Rainbow Chart – Dynamic Analysis
meta.disclaimer: The Rainbow Chart is not financial advice. Past performance is not an indication of future results. It is a fun, visual way to look at long-term price movements.

original_model.interpretation: [Original model] Purple band added in later chart versions when price fell below the classic rainbow. It marks an extreme downside gap vs the original model.

dynamic_model.interpretation: [Dynamic model] Among the lowest bands: historically linked to panic or late bear-market phases. The label is a meme; it is not financial advice.
